entries.clue: Wine is lifted at the altar in this grand stemmed cup
Stone-hurling war engine, or a child's Y-shaped elastic toy
Everyday word for a hot mugful, asked for without any fuss
Chunky saucerless cousin of the teacup, home of the builders' brew
Shiny gold bloom of the water meadow, ranunculus by another name
Short, restricted pull, thicker and sweeter than standard
Thin tube for sucking up a drink — or the last one, proverbially
Striped gatecrashers homing in on the open lemonade
Two riders thundering at each other on opposite sides of a wooden rail
Tenth of the harvest owed to the parish, stored in a barn built for it
Espresso cut with an equal splash of warm milk
